svg.title: FNN and ResNet: Continuous Training, Identity and Residual Contributions
svg.desc: FNN, ResNet and Residual occupy three fixed plots with unchanged axes throughout the animation. Both models exist from step 0 and train continuously to step 50 with identical starting tensors, three hidden layers, 593 parameters and matching optimization settings. All curves, residual targets, Train MSE and OOS MSE share one clock and stay visible. The permanent green Identity formula displays one actual hidden feature before and after the parameter-free shortcut; its input and output are equal in every checkpoint. Only after training finishes do copied residual distances move to the right plot and a copy of the learned correction return to the middle plot. These explanatory motions hold both models and their metrics fixed. The gray b curve is a carried output contribution, not the identity function itself.
